blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 Government Approves Pan-India Rollout of ₹60,000 Crore 'PM-SETU' ITI Skilling Scheme. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Upgrades 200 ITI clusters with ₹1,237.58 crore initial Strategic Investment Plans.
National Rollout: ₹60,000 crore PM-SETU (Pradhan Mantri Skilling & Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs) rolled out across 200 clusters.
Strategic Investment Plans: Cleared 5 SIPs worth ₹1,237.58 crore to upgrade ITI clusters in Odisha, Gujarat, and Telangana.
Total scheme outlay (₹60,000 crore) vs initial 5-cluster SIP outlay (₹1,237.58 crore).
